scope.native_definition: Original CIFAR-10 Python release, 32x32 RGB, ten classes; no MedMNIST, generated, substituted, or proxy images.
scope.attack: Audited all-to-one bottom-right patch attack from the archived paper5 native CIFAR-10 program
scope.decision_unit: unique source training record; repeated optimizer exposures are not duplicated in the audit table

trusted_split.source: official CIFAR-10 test split, target class only

observation.feature: concatenated tanh hidden1 (256-D) and tanh penultimate (128-D)

primary.name: CF-CMD-U
primary.rule: Two-fold target-candidate cross-fit raw mean direction; each half is scored by the opposite half; conservative upper-tail rank p-values from the separate calibration split.

matched_baselines.name: target_centroid_distance
matched_baselines.rule: Euclidean distance from the trusted target-class reference centroid with the same calibration split and alpha.

matched_baselines.name: crossfit_spectral
matched_baselines.rule: Two-fold spectral-signature score; the principal direction is fit on the opposite candidate half and calibrated on the same trusted calibration split.

victim_eligibility.asr_scope: all 9000 non-target official test images after the frozen patch

primary_detector_gate.auc_scope: poison versus legitimate target-class clean records within the target-assigned candidate population
primary_detector_gate.confirmation_claim_requires: at least 8 eligible victims and pooled TPR >= 0.90 and pooled target-clean FPR <= 0.05
primary_detector_gate.otherwise: retain and report a negative or inconclusive result without retuning

stopping_rules: Run a synthetic detector smoke test plus dataset/checkpoint integrity and forward-pass checks first; smoke uses no real candidate detection outcome and cannot enter confirmation aggregates.
Abort a victim on dataset integrity, checkpoint file hash, checkpoint state hash, architecture, config, candidate-count, non-finite-score, or collapsed-direction mismatch.
Do not replace failed or ineligible seeds.
Do not tune feature layer, alpha, trusted budgets, target class, attack, or detector after reading confirmation detector outcomes.
If fewer than eight of ten victims are eligible, mark the native attack-development endpoint inconclusive and do not pool a population-level detector claim.
GTSRB is a separate feasibility line and cannot substitute for this CIFAR-10 confirmation block.
